title: a survey on deep learning for 2d and 3d human pose estimation
core_idea: Provide a detailed survey of deep learning methods for 2D and 3D human pose estimation across single-person and multi-person, image-based and video-based scenarios; categorize and compare methods and datasets, summarize evaluation metrics and loss functions, discuss challenges (occlusion, data scarcity, privacy, generalization, complexity), and outline future research directions and applications.
tldr: Comprehensive review of deep learning approaches, datasets, metrics, challenges, and future directions for 2D and 3D human pose estimation in images and video.
